title: I'm almost ready to release my first game with AI-assisted code and all human-made visual and audio art.
author: Firepious
selftext: I have been working on the game for around three months in my free time outside of work (not related to game development whatsoever), and am planning to release the first public playable version on itch at [firepious.itch.io/turtley](http://firepious.itch.io/turtley) on September 10th. Apologies if this is not the place to share, but I figured some of you may be interested in checking out the video at least! I hope to do a mobile release as well as port to my Anbernic RG34XXSP at some point for anyone who is into retro handhelds haha. I'd appreciate any genuine thoughts or feedback! Thank you and take care.
